"""Set the same NVIDIA library search path as the BH Rune serve.sh, then exec author CLI."""
import glob
import runpy
import os
import site
import sys
from pathlib import Path
libs = []
for root in site.getsitepackages():
    libs.extend(sorted(p for p in glob.glob(root + "/nvidia/*/lib") if os.path.isdir(p)))
    cu13 = root + "/nvidia/cu13/lib"
    if os.path.isdir(cu13) and cu13 not in libs:
        libs.append(cu13)
if os.environ.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH"):
    libs.append(os.environ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"])
os.environ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = ":".join(libs)
cli = str(Path(sys.executable).parent / "surogate")
sys.argv = [cli, *sys.argv[1:]]
runpy.run_path(cli, run_name="__main__")
